# DESIGN.md — বনের মহিষ / Boner Mohis

**Brand:** Boner Mohis (Latin wordmark) · Bangla secondary: বনের মহিষ
**Product:** Prepaid electricity meter tracker for **DESCO prepaid** users —
balance, usage, low-balance warnings. Android app + Chrome extension.
**Owner:** Adommo LLC (product line) · **Market:** Bangladesh
**System name (internal only, never shown):** Filament
**Version:** 1.0.0 · **Updated:** 2026-08-21

> **Changelog 2.1.0 (fresh restart — supersedes all prior locks):**
> 1. Logo locked: **Spark-line** mark + Latin **Boner Mohis** wordmark (Space Grotesk 500, outlined). New §7.5.
> 2. Wordmark hero is now **Latin** per founder decision; Bangla wordmark demoted to localized/secondary. §1, §4 updated. (Risk noted in §1.)
> 3. Dark-mode semantic table completed — five missing tokens added, all WCAG-verified. §3.
> 4. §4.3 corrected: the name has **no conjuncts**; the real risk is matra/vowel-sign placement and the ষ glyph.
> 5. Light focus-ring contrast corrected 3.42 → **3.23** (still ≥3 UI threshold).

---

## Overview

§1

Know your DESCO prepaid balance, see usage patterns, and get warned days
before the balance runs out.

**Essence:** Never surprised by an empty meter.
**Tagline:** বাতি জ্বলতে থাকুক — *keep the lights on.*
**Name:** বনের মহিষ / Boner Mohis — the wild buffalo. Unbothered,
unhurried, impossible to catch off guard.

### Name lockup rule (v2.1)

| Surface | Form |
|---|---|
| Primary wordmark / logo, store listings, marketing | **Boner Mohis** — Latin, Space Grotesk 500 (the locked hero) |
| Bangla surfaces / localized headings | **বনের মহিষ** — Baloo Da 2, secondary/localized wordmark |
| App UI copy | Bangla-first per §9 (the logo is Latin; the interface is Bangla) |
| Domain / package / handles | `bonermohis.com` |
| Spoken | Bangla pronunciation always |

> **⚠ Owner-approved risk (flagged, not blocking):** with the Latin wordmark
> as hero, "Boner Mohis" appears prominently in English on the Play Store and
> Chrome Web Store — surfaces reviewed by English speakers, where "boner"
> reads as slang. This was a deliberate founder decision on the fresh restart.
> Softening options remain open (romanization tweak, or Bangla-hero-with-Latin-sub)
> but are not required.
>
> **Closed 2026-09-26 (D-081): no softening.** The Latin hero stays as ratified. One mitigation
> is adopted because it costs nothing: every English-reviewed store surface (Play Store and
> Chrome Web Store titles, promo tiles) pairs the two scripts — **"Boner Mohis — বনের মহিষ"** —
> so a reviewer reads it as a Bangla proper noun, which it is. Romanization tweaks are rejected:
> they would break the pronunciation rule ("Bangla pronunciation always").

### Data source — DESCO prepaid; design supports both states

DESCO prepaid has no confirmed public balance API, and Play Store restricts
SMS-reading permissions — so the product is **manual-entry-first**, with an
optional linked/portal-derived sync as a second-class enhancement. Both states
appear in every balance surface:

- `as of 9:12pm · synced`
- `as of 9:12pm · manual entry`

**Sync — decided 2026-09-26 (D-081): v1 ships manual entry only.** Portal-derived sync would
mean storing the user's DESCO credentials and scraping a site that has not agreed to it — a
credential and terms risk the §12 compliance notes already warn about. The `synced` state stays
in the design so an official DESCO API can be adopted without a redesign; until one exists,
every balance reads `manual entry`.

The design must **never imply official DESCO affiliation** (see §10, §12).

---

## 2. Design principles

1. **Glanceable first.** Days remaining and the charge bar read across a room.
2. **Calm, never alarmist.** The product reduces meter anxiety.
3. **Numbers are sacred.** Balance, units, taka in mono, generously sized,
   always with a freshness timestamp *and its source*.
4. **Ember means attention, calmly.** The accent doubles as the low-balance state.
5. **Warm domestic light.** Never cold black glass; dark mode is first-class.

### Rules
- **No separate warning colour.** Ember *is* the warning. Tiers: **ok green · low ember · critical red.**
- Accent appears on primary actions, links, and the low-balance state.
- No gradients. Never pure white or pure black backgrounds. No neon.

## Typography

§4 · Typography — bilingual

| Role | Family | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| **Latin wordmark / logo** | **Space Grotesk** (Medium 500) | The hero wordmark "Boner Mohis" — outlined in the logo files |
| Latin display / balance figure | **Space Grotesk** (Medium) | Hero balance number, Latin headings |
| Latin body / UI | **DM Sans** | Latin interface text |
| **Bangla display / secondary wordmark** | **Baloo Da 2** | বনের মহিষ (localized), Bangla headings |
| **Bangla body / UI** | **Noto Sans Bengali** | All Bangla interface text |
| Mono | **DM Mono** | Units, taka, timestamps, logs |

All SIL OFL, bundled in-app. **Type scale:** 13 / 15 / 17 / 21 / 26 / 32 / 44 px. Radius **12px**.
**Line-height** *(pinned 2026-09-26, D-081 — was unstated)*: Latin display 1.15 · UI 1.5 · prose
1.6. Bangla adds exactly **+0.15**: display 1.3 · UI 1.65 · prose 1.75. Body size 15px.

### Bilingual rules (locked)
1. **Latin numerals always** for balance, units, taka, timestamps — DM Mono, even inside Bangla UI.
2. **Bangla needs its own leading** — +0.15 line-height over the Latin equivalent (values above).
3. **Glyph check before lock (corrected v2.1):** বনের মহিষ contains **no conjuncts**.
   The real rendering risks are **matra / vowel-sign placement** (the ি i-kar on
   হ, the ে e-kar) and the **ষ glyph** (less common, renders inconsistently). The
   Bangla wordmark must be outlined to vector paths **and** checked by a Bangla reader.
4. Mixed-script data lines always use the Latin numeral form.

§5 · Space, shape, elevation

| Property | Value |

| Spacing grid | 8px — 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / 32 / 48 / 64 |
| Content max-width | 480px app · 1040px marketing |

| Touch target min | **48px** |
| Density | Roomy throughout |
| Grid | 4 col app · 12 col marketing; 16px app screen margin · 24px marketing gutter *(added 2026-09-26, D-081)* |

### Motion *(added 2026-09-26, D-081)*

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| duration-fast | 120ms | press, toggle, segment fill step |
| duration-base | 200ms | sheet, dialog, toast |
| duration-slow | 320ms | balance figure change |
| easing | `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` | all |

Calm, never alarmist (§2): nothing pulses or blinks, including at the critical tier. Under
`prefers-reduced-motion` / the Android "remove animations" setting, everything is instant.

## Components

§6 · Component library specification

*Written out 2026-09-26 (D-081). Was a one-line stub: "Unchanged from 2.0 — every component in
light and dark … foundations, primitives, composites, navigation/shell, domain components,
states." 2.0 is not in the repository, so the list is specified here.* Every component in light
and dark; dark is first-class. The freshness row — timestamp + `synced`/`manual entry` in mono —
appears under every balance figure.

### 6.1 Foundations
Colour swatches (both modes) · type scale in Latin and Bangla side by side · spacing · radius ·
focus ring · motion specimen · icon specimen · charge-bar anatomy.

### 6.2 Primitives
- **Buttons** — primary (ember fill; white label light, **soot-900 label dark**, §3),
  secondary (outline `border-strong`), ghost, destructive; 48px; default / pressed / focus /
  disabled / loading.
- **Number field** — DM Mono, Latin numerals, units suffix (`kWh`, `৳`), numeric keypad.
- **Text field, select, date picker, toggle, checkbox, radio** — all states, Bangla labels.
- **Tier chip** — ok · low · critical, colour + text label, never colour alone.
- **Freshness row** — `as of 9:12pm · manual entry`, DM Mono 13px, `text-muted`.
- **Snackbar** · **Tooltip** (extension only).

### 6.3 Composites
- **Home balance card** — the one card with a shadow (light): meter name, balance in Space
  Grotesk 500 at 44px with ৳, units remaining, **days-left estimate labelled "estimate"**,
  charge bar, freshness row.
- **Usage chart** — daily kWh bars (soot-700 / soot-300), recharge events as ember ticks;
  real axes, units labelled.
- **Recharge log row** — date, amount ৳, units, source.
- **Meter row** — meter name, number (mono), tier chip.
- **Alert settings** — thresholds in days and in units, quiet hours.
- **Add-meter flow** — meter number, nickname, current balance, date — three fields, one screen.

### 6.4 Navigation & shell
- **Bottom navigation (app)** — Home · Usage · Meters · Alerts · Settings, 64px.
- **Extension popup** — 360px wide: balance mirror card, tier chip, "Update balance" action.
- **Extension options page** — meters, alerts, language.
- **Marketing header / footer** — footer carries the no-affiliation line (§12).

### 6.5 States
Empty (no meter yet — "Add your meter to start") · stale data (freshness older than 48h shown in
`text-secondary` with "Update balance") · offline · error.

### 6.6 Charge bar spec (pins §7)
10 segments, 4px gap, 12px tall in cards (8px in rows), 2px radius. Filled = ember-600 light /
ember-400 dark (ok-tier green and critical-tier red at those tiers). Hollow = 1px
`border-strong` outline. **The "glowing" active segment** is the last filled segment with a
**static 2px outer ring in ember-300** — no blur, no animation, consistent with "no neon" (§3).
**Loading motif:** segments fill left to right, one per 120ms, then hold; it does not loop more
than once per fetch. Reduced motion: three segments shown filled, static.

---

## 7. Signature element — the charge bar (in-app UI)

A segmented horizontal level indicator: filled segments solid, the active
segment glowing ember, remaining segments hollow outlines. **Permitted uses:**
the balance display, state indicators, the loading motif.

**Never style it to resemble a phone battery icon** — banned.
**Note (v2.1):** the in-app charge bar is distinct from the brand **spark-line
mark** (§7.5); they share the ember accent but are different objects.

---

## 7.5 Logo — LOCKED (v2.1) · "Spark-line"

**Mark:** a spark-**line** — a minimal usage sparkline whose leading point is a
solid **ember disc**. It reads as *usage trend + your live balance, glowing*: the
graph is the mark, the ember is the signal. No battery, no bolt, no house.

**Geometry (100 viewBox):**
- Full (≥48px): polyline `M14 56 L38 46 L62 52 L86 32`, stroke-width 6, round caps; ember `circle cx86 cy32 r7`.
- Compact (≤32px, favicon/toolbar): `M14 56 L50 44 L86 30`, stroke-width 9; ember `r11`.

**Wordmark:** "Boner Mohis" in **Space Grotesk 500, outlined to vector paths**
(no live text in any logo file).

**Colour:**
- Light: stroke soot-900 `#181510`, ember ember-600 `#B25409`.
- Dark: stroke `#EFEBE2`, ember ember-400 `#E88540`.
- Mono fallback: stroke + ember both `currentColor`.

**State mechanic:** the ember disc *is* the state signal. Recolour it
**ok `#6FBF7C` · low ember · critical `#F0736A`** (dark) / `#2C7B38 · ember · #C22A21` (light)
for the extension toolbar icon — one glyph, three states.

**Clearspace:** ember-disc diameter on all sides.
**Min size:** compact mark to 16px (tiled); full lockup wordmark legible to ~140px wide.
**Never:** stretch, recolour outside the palette, add shadow/glow/gradient,
rebuild the wordmark in another typeface, or let the mark read as the in-app charge bar.

**Files:** `assets/svg/` — marks, lockups (horizontal/stacked, light/dark), wordmark, icon,
maskable app icon, toolbar states (`toolbar-{ok,low,critical}.svg`); `geometry.json` at the brand
root. *(Corrected 2026-09-26: this pointed at a `bonermohis_logo_pack/` directory that does not
exist in the repository.)*

---

## 8. Iconography

Lucide-style rounded 1.5px stroke. Domain glyphs: meter, bolt (recharge), bell,
home/shop, sync. **Banned:** neon bolts, 3D houses, smart-home renders, **battery icons**.

---

## 9. Voice & tone

Bangla-first UI, domestic-warm, brief. Sentence case. No exclamation marks.

**Notification grammar (locked):**
`[Meter name]: ~[N] days left ([units] units). Recharge when convenient.`
Critical tier drops "when convenient" and adds nothing panicked.

**Honesty rules (locked):** every days-remaining figure is an **estimate**;
alerts are **best-effort**; the in-app balance is authoritative.

---

## 10. Content conventions

Bangla UI copy with Latin numerals. Realistic data only. **No invented accuracy
claims, no fake user counts, no implied affiliation with DESCO or any utility.** No lorem ipsum.

---

## 11. Accessibility

- All pairings meet WCAG 2.1 AA (§3, computationally verified).
- Focus always visible: 2px `#D86913` (light) / `#D96A14` (dark) ring, 2px offset — verified in **both** modes (light <!-- AUTO:doc-ratio -->3.23:1<!-- /AUTO -->; dark <!-- AUTO:doc-ratio -->5.22:1<!-- /AUTO --> bg / <!-- AUTO:doc-ratio -->4.66:1<!-- /AUTO --> surface).
- Touch targets ≥48px.
- State tiers pair colour with a text label — never colour alone.
- Dark mode is a first-class target; Bangla meets the same thresholds with its own leading.

---

## 12. Compliance notes

- **Play Store SMS policy:** manual-entry-first; functions fully without SMS permissions.
- **Credential handling:** any linked sync states plainly what is stored and where.
- **No ads, ever.**
- **No implied DESCO affiliation** anywhere in mark, copy, or store listing.

---

## Do's and Don'ts

§14 · Do / Don't

**Do:** label every estimate · show source + freshness on every balance · keep
dark mode equal in quality · keep the calm tone even at critical.
**Don't:** panic styling · imply DESCO status · use a battery metaphor · run ads ·
add a separate warning colour beside ember · render data in Bengali numerals ·
let the spark-line mark be mistaken for the in-app charge bar.

> **`usage-sheet.html` — added 2026-09-02.** Every brand now ships one: side-by-side
> DO / DON'T panels for logo and mark placement, rendered from the committed SVGs against
> this brand's real grounds, plus the machine-readable usage rules and measured contrast.
> The DON'T panels are produced by actually making the mistake, so the failure is visible
> rather than described. Generated by `_ops/scripts/gen-usage-sheet.mjs` — do not hand-edit.
